prompt.es: Escucha la charla y resume tres ideas y dos detalles.

answer.text: The lecturer outlined three reasons why cities are planting more trees. According to her, the first reason is that trees cool the streets, and shade can make a street up to five degrees cooler in summer. The second reason is rain: the ground near a tree takes in more water, so there is less flooding after a storm. The third reason is that trees are good for people's minds, because residents who live near trees feel less stressed. She gave one example from a large city, where two thousand trees were planted along one street; after three years, the council reported that the street was noticeably cooler. She went on to give a detail about the costs: a young tree needs water every week for two years, and that costs money. To summarise, the lecturer said that trees are not a quick fix, but they are a good long-term investment.

The talk was about planting trees in cities. The speaker gave three main ideas. Firstly, trees make streets cooler, by up to 5 degrees in summer, because of the shade. Secondly, trees help when it rains, since the ground takes in water and there is less flooding. Thirdly, people who live near trees seem to feel less stress. As an example, she explained that two thousand trees were planted along one street in a large city, and three years later the street was cooler. She also mentioned a detail about the costs: young trees need water every week for two years, which is expensive for the council. In conclusion, the lecturer said that trees are not a quick solution, but they are a good investment for the future.

feedback.es: El resumen recoge las tres razones, al menos dos detalles de la charla, atribuye las ideas a la conferenciante y cierra con una conclusión.

origin.text: Escucha la charla sobre los árboles en las ciudades (puedes oírla varias veces) y escribe un resumen en inglés de 130 a 250 palabras: tres ideas principales, dos detalles o ejemplos y una frase final. Atribuye las ideas a la conferenciante y no añadas datos que no oigas.
origin.audio: Today I want to talk about why cities are planting more trees. There are three main reasons. First, trees cool the streets. Shade can make a street up to five degrees cooler in summer. Second, trees help with rain. The ground near a tree takes in more water, so there is less flooding after a storm. Third, trees are good for people's minds. Studies suggest that residents who live near trees feel less stressed. One example comes from a large city, where two thousand trees were planted along one street. After three years, the council reported that the street was noticeably cooler. However, trees need care. A young tree needs water every week for two years, and that costs money. In short, trees are not a quick fix, but they are a good long-term investment.
